history.content: Hi, my phone has absolutely no signal—no bars, no internet, and I can't send picture messages. Nothing is coming through at all.

I can help you with this issue. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide either your phone number, customer ID, or your full name and date of birth? This will allow me to check your line status and assist you further.
My phone number is +1-617-555-0148 and my name is Sofia Martinez.

Your phone line is currently suspended, which is why you have no signal, internet, or ability to send picture messages. However, I checked your recent bills and both are paid, so the suspension is not due to an overdue bill.

Would you like me to attempt to resume your service now? If so, please reboot your device after I restore your line to regain service.
Yes, please try to resume my service. Let me know when to reboot my phone and I'll do it.

Your service has been restored. Please reboot your phone now to regain signal and full functionality. After restarting, you should have service, internet, and be able to send picture messages again.

If you still experience issues after rebooting, let me know and I’ll help you further.

response.result: Line LN-8830142 has been resumed and is now Active.

history.content: My phone rebooted successfully, but I still have no signal, no internet, and can't send picture messages. Nothing has changed after the restart.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your line is now active but you still have no signal, let’s do some troubleshooting steps to identify the cause.

Could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know what icons or messages you see at the top of your screen? This will help determine if there are issues like Airplane Mode being on, SIM card problems, or other connectivity issues.
I see excellent signal bars, 5G, data enabled, and it's connected to Chestnut-5G. The battery is at 87%.

Thank you for the details. Since you see excellent signal bars, 5G, and data enabled, but are also connected to Wi-Fi (Chestnut-5G), let’s check if the issue is with mobile data or MMS specifically.

Could you please try turning off Wi-Fi on your phone and let me know if you have internet access using only mobile data? This will help us determine if your mobile data connection is working properly.
Wi-Fi is now off and I'm disconnected from any wireless network, but I still don't have any internet access over mobile data. Websites and apps are not working.

Thank you for checking. Since you have excellent signal and 5G but no internet access over mobile data, let’s continue troubleshooting.

Could you please run a speed test on your phone and let me know the result? This will help determine if your phone is able to connect to the internet at all via mobile data.
The speed test actually shows I'm connected, with excellent download speed and excellent connection quality on 5G using cellular data. It looks like everything is working now.

That’s great news! It appears your mobile data connection is now working properly. Sometimes, it can take a few moments after a line is resumed and the device is rebooted for full connectivity to return.

You should now be able to use the internet and send picture messages (MMS) as normal. If you experience any further issues with your service, please let me know and I’ll be happy to assist you further.
Thanks, everything is working perfectly now—my signal is excellent, I'm on 5G, my internet is fast, and I can send picture messages. The problem is fixed.
You’re very welcome! I’m glad to hear everything is working perfectly now. If you ever need assistance in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!
